content: n institutional database for quality enhancement. Prepare the Annual Quality Assurance Report (AQAR) as per NAAC guidelines. Member Responsibilities Members of the IQAC must generate and promote awareness in the institution and devote time to procedural details. The coordinator should be changed every two to three years to encourage fresh initiatives and renewed quality activity. Selection should consider senior administrators, departmental representation, and committed management representative
